scientific_question: At the five frozen nine-parameter Fourier fits, how do local Jacobian conditioning, period-amplitude compensation and held-out linearized sensitivity vary across contiguous month ranges, and how does this differ from prediction accuracy and period stability?
analysis_type: Read-only post-hoc local-linearization and harmonic-correlation diagnostics at five frozen native fits; no refitting or new experiment

dataset_scope.response: monthly averaged atmospheric pressure difference between Easter Island and Darwin, Australia

fold_rule.assignment_rule: Use inclusive integer month ranges identical to the frozen native folds; each month occurs once and all predictions remain in the frozen point order
fold_rule.frozen_fit_rule: Use native_parameters and training_rss from each frozen fold exactly; no curve_fit call, parameter update or holdout change is permitted
fold_rule.test_metric_rule: Recomputed native_test_metrics must exactly reproduce the frozen metric dictionary

jacobian_rule.singular_rule: b4=0, b7=0 or any non-finite Jacobian is retained as a failure; no replacement by certified fits, period bounds or post-hoc parameter repair

local_rule.column_scaling: Divide each Jacobian column by its Euclidean norm; require finite nonzero norms
local_rule.numerical_rank: Count scaled singular values greater than rank_tolerance; preserve rank deficiency rather than forcing rank nine
local_rule.sigma2: training_RSS/(train_count-9), using the frozen fold-specific degrees of freedom [125,125,125,126,126]
local_rule.standard_errors: sqrt(diag(covariance)); local linearized standard errors only
local_rule.interpretation: Local linearization at each frozen fit; rank, conditioning, standard errors and sensitivity do not prove global structural identifiability, calibrated uncertainty or physical period mechanisms

harmonic_correlation_rule.period_pair: Record absolute correlation between b4 and b7
harmonic_correlation_rule.own_amplitudes: Record maximum absolute correlation of b4 with b5,b6 and of b7 with b8,b9
harmonic_correlation_rule.cross_harmonic_blocks: Record maximum absolute correlation between the first and second long blocks
harmonic_correlation_rule.annual_long_blocks: Record maximum absolute correlation between the annual block and all six long-block parameters
harmonic_correlation_rule.period_ratio: Record b4/b7 when both periods are nonzero, as a descriptive ratio only
harmonic_correlation_rule.interpretation: These are local parameter-correlation diagnostics, not posterior dependence, causal coupling, new physical cycles or a single stability score

parameter_stability_rule.statistics: For every parameter across five frozen fits, record minimum, maximum, median, range and per-fold local standard errors
parameter_stability_rule.period_emphasis: Report b4 and b7 values, ranges and local relative standard errors alongside native RMSE
parameter_stability_rule.prediction_stability_scope: Lower held-out RMSE does not imply unique, invariant or physically endogenous periods or amplitudes

known_answer_rule.interpretation: The existing optimizer-known-answer mismatch and certified-parameter forward pass remain separate from all five-fold local diagnostics

output_rule.word: papers/前沿共生ENSO原生参数可识别性_图文完整版.docx

prohibitions: No refitting, retuning, new starts, new fold assignments, period bounds or new parameter values
No conversion of local Jacobians, ranks, covariances, harmonic correlations or delta-method sensitivity into global identifiability or calibrated intervals
No transfer of rational denominator, ellipsoid, box or continuous-safety claims to the native Fourier model
No claim that lower held-out RMSE proves unique, invariant or physically endogenous parameters or new physical periods
No hiding of rank deficiency, non-finite values, failed variance estimates, zero periods, fold-level parameter variation or the known-answer optimizer mismatch
No replacement of the five frozen fold fits by the full-data certified parameters or by the full-data optimizer fit
